title: Coupled Scene Graph Anticipation: When With-Constraint Recall Hides Structural Inconsistency
abstract: arXiv:2611.06738v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scene Graph Anticipation (SGA) predicts object relationships in future video frames. Continuous-time SGA models evolve each subject-object pair with an independent Neural ODE, so relationships sharing an entity cannot influence one another during integration, and nothing prevents mutually exclusive predictions, such as "sitting on" and "standing on", for the same pair. We introduce CoupledSGA, which links such relationships through a Relationship Interaction Graph with graph attention inside the ODE vector field, and adds a Structural Consistency Loss ($\mathcal{L}_{SC}$) based on a matrix of mutually exclusive predicates.   Developing CoupledSGA revealed a limitation of the evaluation protocol. With-Constraint evaluation keeps one predicate per group for each subject-object pair, so its R@K and mR@K cannot capture the within-group violations targeted by $\mathcal{L}_{SC}$: we prove they are unchanged whenever each group's winning pred

translated_title: 耦合场景图预测：当带约束召回率掩盖结构不一致性时
translated_abstract: 场景图预测（SGA）用于预测未来视频帧中物体之间的关系。连续时间SGA模型使用独立的神经常微分方程（Neural ODE）来演化每个主语-宾语对，因此在积分过程中共享同一实体的关系无法相互影响，并且没有任何机制阻止对同一对物体做出互斥的预测，例如“坐在...上”和“站在...上”。我们提出了CoupledSGA，它通过在ODE向量场内部嵌入图注意力的关系交互图（Relationship Interaction Graph）来关联这些关系，并添加了基于互斥谓词矩阵的结构一致性损失（L_SC）。开发CoupledSGA的过程揭示了现有评估协议的一个局限性。带约束评估为每个主语-宾语对在每个组中仅保留一个谓词，因此其R@K和mR@K无法捕捉L_SC所针对的组内违规情况：我们证明，只要每组的获胜谓词保持不变，这些指标就不会发生变化。
tldr: 本文提出CoupledSGA，通过关系交互图与结构一致性损失耦合共享实体的关系以避免互斥预测，并证明带约束评估指标会掩盖这种结构不一致性。
en_tdlr: CoupledSGA couples entity-sharing relationships via a Relationship Interaction Graph with graph attention inside the ODE vector field and a Structural Consistency Loss to prevent mutually exclusive predictions, while proving that With-Constraint recall metrics hide such structural inconsistencies.
